name: Laser Distance Sensor
description: The reading can be read from the sensor's number output and is measured in metres (1 metre = 4 blocks). Can be pivoted up to 0.125 turns using composite input.
shortDescription: A laser distance sensor with a maximum measurement range of 4000m.

logicNodes.label: Active
logicNodes.description: Controls whether or not the laser is active.

logicNodes.label: Wavelength
logicNodes.description: The specific light wavelength to emit (whole number).

logicNodes.label: Pivot
logicNodes.description: Inputs for laser X/Y pivot. (Value 1 : Pivot X) (Value 2 : Pivot Y)
